note: Names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's own words. Every guide and step below is written for this entry, in our own words, and cites its sources by number. No text is copied from any guide.

stages.title: Chapters 1–2 · Learn Leonida
stages.blurb: Play the opening, meet Lucia and Jason, learn the map — and bank the one trophy that might not come back.
stages.desc: Play the opening, meet Lucia and Jason, learn the map — and bank the one trophy that might not come back.

stages.title: Chapters 3–4 · Vice City opens up
stages.blurb: Vice City opens up: more missions, more systems, first stranger strands.
stages.desc: Vice City opens up: more missions, more systems, first stranger strands.

stages.title: Finale & stranger strands
stages.blurb: Finish the story, close every stranger strand, and keep the partner trophies in mind.
stages.desc: Finish the story, close every stranger strand, and keep the partner trophies in mind.

stages.title: Activities & skills
stages.blurb: Races, shooting ranges, hunts and every activity type once — the skill grind.
stages.desc: Races, shooting ranges, hunts and every activity type once — the skill grind.

stages.title: Robberies & money
stages.blurb: Shops, vaults, trucks and gang operations — bring a partner and a fast car.
stages.desc: Shops, vaults, trucks and gang operations — bring a partner and a fast car.

stages.title: Collectibles & exploration
stages.blurb: Cards, WAiNK spots, meditation spots and every corner of Leonida.
stages.desc: Cards, WAiNK spots, meditation spots and every corner of Leonida.

stages.title: The 100% checklist
stages.blurb: The in-game checklist under Progress > Stats: 70 of 80 challenges, vehicles, animals and the rest.
stages.desc: The in-game checklist under Progress > Stats: 70 of 80 challenges, vehicles, animals and the rest.

disputes.title: Is the Chapter 1 balcony meditation required?
disputes.sideA: PowerPyx counts the balcony meditation at Jason's house as one of the 18 spots and flags it as the one possibly missable trophy.
disputes.sideB: Other lists say no missable trophies are confirmed yet, and the in-game map does not mark the balcony as a Meditation Spot.
disputes.call: Do it in Chapter 1 and keep a Chapter 1 save. It costs one morning and covers both versions.

disputes.title: How long does 100% really take?
disputes.sideA: PowerPyx rates the platinum at about 200 hours, difficulty 4/10.
disputes.sideB: Push Square says to set aside up to 300 hours or more.
disputes.call: Plan for 200 hours of play; budget 300 if you chase every collectible instead of only what the checklist asks for.

disputes.title: How many card sets does 100% need?
disputes.sideA: The trophy asks for 3 complete Collectible Card sets.
disputes.sideB: KeenGamer and Push Square list 15 complete sets (of 18 total) for the 100% checklist.
disputes.call: Finish 3 sets for the trophy, then keep going to 15 — the checklist counts them, and the trophy pops on the way.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops by itself once the other 54 are earned. There is no separate task — it is the finish line of the whole list.

steps.t: Earn the other 54 trophies; the platinum unlocks automatically with the last one.
Follow the 7-stage roadmap in order: story first, then the 100% checklist, then cleanup.
Check the in-game 100% checklist (Progress > Stats) after the story to see what is left.
Keep one manual save per chapter, since there is no mission replay and no New Game+.
Never use a cheat on your trophy save: cheats disable trophies and saving.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The opening mission, Gone Fishing. Story only — play it and the trophy pops. It is the first of four fishing spots that matter for the fishing trophies.

steps.t: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to the end; the trophy pops on completion.
Use the fishing spots in this mission to learn the fishing controls for later challenges.
After the mission, check the tracker: this is fishing spot 1 of 4 in the opening stretch.
Keep the Chapter 1 save from this mission — the balcony meditation later in Chapter 1 is the missable one.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Story only — it pops when the chapter ends.

steps.t: Play through Chapter 1's missions in order until the chapter closes.
Before the chapter ends, do the balcony meditation with Lucia (see trophy 28).
Save manually at the end of Chapter 1; there is no mission replay.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Story only — it pops when the chapter ends.

steps.t: Play through Chapter 2's missions in order until the chapter closes.
Pick up the optional missions marked on the map as they appear; they feed the stranger strands.
Save manually at the end of Chapter 2.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Story only — it pops when the chapter ends.

steps.t: Play through Chapter 3's missions in order until the chapter closes.
Vice City opens up here: try one activity type (races, fishing, shooting range) to start Master of None.
Save manually at the end of Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Story only — it pops when the chapter ends.

steps.t: Play through Chapter 4's missions in order until the chapter closes.
Finish any stranger strands that are open before the finale; most quest givers return after the story.
Save manually at the end of Chapter 4.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the fifth chapter. Story only — it pops at the credits, and free roam opens right after.

steps.t: Play the fifth chapter to the final mission and finish it.
After the credits, free roam opens and the 100% checklist appears under Progress > Stats.
Do not start using cheats now: they only unlock after the story and they disable trophies and saving.
Make a clean post-story save before starting the 100% cleanup.
Everything needed for the platinum is still reachable in free roam except the Chapter 1 meditation.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the Breakfast Run mission. Story only, but it sits in an early chapter window, so do it when it appears and do not leave it for later.

steps.t: Take the Breakfast Run mission when it appears and follow it through its 4 stops.
Stay with your partner through the run; the mission is a partner job.
Finish the mission to pop the trophy; it cannot be replayed.
Save right after it, before moving on to the next chapter.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist mission. Story only — it pops when the heist is done.

steps.t: Take The Cartel Heist when it appears and finish it.
Heists pay well: bank the cash toward the $100,000 spending trophy.
Save after the mission; heist missions cannot be replayed.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the Child's Play mission. Story only — it pops when the mission is done.

steps.t: Take the Child's Play mission when it appears and finish it.
Follow the mission markers; there is no branching that locks the trophy.
Save after the mission.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the Headliners mission. Story only — it pops when the mission is done.

steps.t: Take the Headliners mission when it appears and finish it.
The mission is a set piece: follow the on-screen prompts and it will complete.
Save after the mission.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the VCIA Takedown mission. Story only — it pops when the mission is done.

steps.t: Take the VCIA Takedown mission when it appears and finish it.
Note the airport layout: you will come back here for the unscheduled departure trophy.
Save after the mission.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the Operation Savage Glory mission. Story only — it pops when the mission is done.

steps.t: Take the Operation Savage Glory mission when it appears and finish it.
It is a combat-heavy mission: stock ammo and armour before starting.
Save after the mission.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion), which appears after the story. It is the hardest trophy: about 100 hours of cleanup, but the checklist is lenient — closer to 60% true completion, with only 70 of 80 challenges needed.

steps.t: Finish the story first: the checklist only appears under Progress > Stats after the credits.
Work the checklist in order: every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest counts in full.
For the partial ones, aim for the checklist numbers: 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 70 of 80 challenges.
Collectibles are only partly required: 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK spots, 33 underwater discoveries.
When the checklist hits 100%, the gold pops; the platinum follows once the last other trophy is done.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game: jumps, under-bridge flights, Knife Flights and base jumps. You only need a little over half of them.

steps.t: Stunts are jumps, under-bridge flights, Knife Flights and base jumps; any 250 of the 397 count.
Use fast cars and bikes on ramps and bridges in free roam; each clean stunt adds to the count.
Track progress in the game (Progress) and in this ledger's counter, 0/250.
The 100% checklist asks for fewer stunts than this trophy, so keep going past the checklist.
The trophy pops at 250 stunts; the remaining 147 are optional.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once: races, shooting range, fishing, bowling, arcade, drone races, stunts, challenges and hunting. One try each is enough.

steps.t: There are 9 activity types: races, shooting range, fishing, bowling, arcade, drone races, stunts, challenges, hunting.
Do one of each: enter a race, shoot one range challenge, fish once, bowl one frame, finish one arcade game.
Win one drone race, pull off one stunt, finish one challenge and hunt one animal to cover the rest.
The trophy pops as soon as the ninth type is tried; no wins are needed.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. The ranges are the same across the map, and the gold medals are not very hard — steady aim and the right weapon for each challenge.

steps.t: There are 42 Shooting Range challenges across the ranges; each needs a gold medal.
Visit a shooting range in free roam and work through its challenges one by one.
Match the weapon to the challenge: rifles for distance, pistols for speed, shotguns up close.
The 100% checklist needs every shooting range done too, so this trophy and the checklist finish together.
The silver pops on the 42nd gold medal.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations. Drone races are short time trials — learn each course's gates, then race clean.

steps.t: There are 14 Top Fun Drone Race locations across Leonida.
Start a drone race at a location and fly the gates; winning marks that location done.
The 100% checklist needs every drone race too, so the trophy and the checklist finish together.
The trophy pops on the 14th win.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts — street, off-road, boat or bike — as long as each race is a different one.

steps.t: Races are found on the map in free roam; each different race won adds 1 to the count.
Vary the type: street races, off-road, boat and bike races all count.
Use the fastest vehicle you own for the race type, and learn the route first.
The trophy pops on the 20th different race win.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal shows up at fishing spots — out-fish him across the 6 fishing challenges and the trophy is yours.

steps.t: Find Cal at a fishing spot and take his fishing challenge.
There are 6 fishing challenges against Cal; beat him in one to pop the trophy.
Fish the spots you learned in Gone Fishing; the same controls apply.
Do it while fishing is open in the story; Cal's challenges are tied to the fishing spots.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Any arcade cabinet in Vice City works — finish a full game and the trophy pops.

steps.t: Find an arcade cabinet in Vice City and start any game.
Play it to the end; quitting early does not count.
The trophy pops when the game completes.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's strand is Lucia-only, so play it as Lucia when it appears.

steps.t: Andy's missions are Lucia-only: switch to Lucia when his strand appears.
Play Andy's missions in order to the final one.
Finish the final mission to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Play Kenton's strand to the end; the final mission pops the trophy.

steps.t: Take Kenton's missions as they appear and play them in order.
The strand involves boats: keep a fast boat handy for the later missions.
Finish the final mission to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Play Billy's strand to the end; the final mission pops the trophy.

steps.t: Take Billy's missions as they appear and play them in order.
Billy's strand is bike-heavy: keep a good motorcycle ready.
Finish the final mission to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. The strands are Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret and two more — each strand ends with its own trophy, and this silver pops when the eighth strand closes.

steps.t: There are 8 stranger strands: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret and two more.
Strands appear as icons on the map; some are character-locked (Andy is Lucia-only, Tyrone and Bret are Jason-only).
Play each strand to its final mission; the strand trophies pop one by one.
Most quest givers return after the story, so strands can be finished in free roam.
The silver pops when the eighth strand is complete.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Play Randy's strand to the end; the final mission pops the trophy.

steps.t: Take Randy's missions as they appear and play them in order.
Randy's strand is about supply runs: keep a fast car and a plane in mind.
Finish the final mission to pop the trophy.
If a mission does not appear, advance the story or switch character and check the map again.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand is Jason-only, so play it as Jason when it appears.

steps.t: Tyrone's missions are Jason-only: switch to Jason when his strand appears.
Play Tyrone's missions in order to the final one.
Finish the final mission to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. POSSIBLY MISSABLE — the first meditation, on the balcony at Jason's house, is only offered in Chapter 1. Do it the morning after Down to Earth, when Lucia is in Jason's kitchen and mentions meditating, and keep a Chapter 1 save. The last spot only opens once you play as both characters, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.

steps.t: MISSABLE WINDOW: in Chapter 1, the morning after the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house.
When Lucia mentions meditating, follow her to the balcony and accept the invitation — this is meditation 1 of 18.
Keep a manual Chapter 1 save before leaving the chapter: there is no mission replay and no New Game+.

Meditate at the other 17 spots across Leonida, including Smooth Sand west of the Capri sandbar, the Buckskin Swamp dock, Emerald River, the Manifest Canyon red rocks, the Moreau ruined mill wheel, the Jutting Cliff tower and the Ascent Mountain peak at Mount Kalaga.
The last spot only opens after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, once you play as both characters; the trophy pops at 18 of 18.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand is Jason-only: track the animal with the binoculars, take the shot, and bring the trophy back.

steps.t: Bret's missions are Jason-only: switch to Jason when his strand appears.
Study animals through the binoculars first — the 100% checklist needs 100 of 255 animals studied.
Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for and finish the hunt to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 card sets in the game; the trophy needs any 3, but the 100% checklist needs 15 — so keep collecting past the trophy.

steps.t: There are 18 Collectible Card sets across Leonida; the trophy needs any 3 complete.
Cards are found in shops, in the world and as mission rewards; check each set's missing cards in the collection menu.
Complete 3 sets to pop the silver — then keep going to 15 sets for the 100% checklist.
Trade duplicates with the in-game card system if a set is one card short.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. The WAiNK app scans landmarks, curiosities and sculptures — a scan counts as discovering the spot, and it also counts toward discovering vehicles.

steps.t: Open the WAiNK app and scan landmarks, curiosities and sculptures: each new location adds 1.
Scan every new vehicle you see too: a WAiNK scan counts as discovering it for Whip It Good.
Work through Leonida's regions one by one; the map shows scanned and unscanned spots.
The silver pops at 100 scanned locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. There are 80 challenges in 8 groups of 10 — the trophy needs any 50, but the 100% checklist needs 70, so keep going and skip the hardest ones.

steps.t: There are 80 challenges in 8 groups of 10; the trophy needs any 50 of them.
Challenges cover combat, driving, flying, hunting and more — pick the groups that suit your play.
The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so the trophy pops on the way to the checklist.
Skip the hardest challenges: with 80 available and only 70 needed for 100%, there is slack.
The trophy pops at 50 completed challenges.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape. It often pops by itself: robbing a bank vault gives you 4 stars at once, so just drive away with your partner.

steps.t: Play with your partner, then build a 4-star Wanted Level — robbing a bank vault does it at once.
Break line of sight and drive out of the search area until the stars clear.
The trophy pops when the heat is gone and both of you are free.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Pick three shops close together, hit them in one run, and keep the wanted level alive between them.

steps.t: Pick 3 shops close together on the map and plan the route between them.
Rob the first shop with your partner, then drive straight to the next — do not lose the Wanted Level.
The trophy pops after the third shop in the same run.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. A WAiNK scan of a new vehicle counts as discovering it, and the 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models — so scan everything you see.

steps.t: Scan every new vehicle with the WAiNK app; a scan counts as discovering it.
There are 277 base vehicle models; the trophy needs 100 and the checklist needs 200.
Check car parks, highways and dealerships for models you have not scanned yet.
The trophy pops at 100 discovered vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Buff your focus first with food, drinks or a shower at home, bring Adrenaline, and use an assault rifle on a group of gang enemies — not soldiers, police or civilians.

steps.t: Buff your focus before the fight with food, drinks or a shower at home, and bring Adrenaline.
Find a group of gang enemies and trigger Combat Focus with an assault rifle.
Take down 5 enemies before the focus runs out; the trophy pops on the fifth.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — the airport. Get to the airfield, grab a plane, and take off without a flight plan.

steps.t: Go to VCIA, the airport on the east side of Vice City.
Get to a plane on the airfield — the one from the VCIA Takedown mission is a good landmark.
Take off without filing a plan; the trophy pops once you are airborne.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with Rhinos — the tanks. Get into a Rhino tank and cause chaos with it; the trophy pops once you have had your fun with one.

steps.t: Find a Rhino tank — they appear at military sites and in high-wanted-level chases.
Get in and drive it; the cannon does the talking.
The trophy pops once you have used the Rhino as the description hints.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, at night, with no alarm raised — masks on, cameras avoided, and out before anyone calls it in.

steps.t: Pick a jewelry store and case it first: note the cameras, the staff and the exits.
Go in at night, masked, and move quietly — avoid the cameras and the staff's line of sight.
Take the jewels and leave without any alarm or detection.
The trophy pops if the whole robbery stays undetected; if you are spotted, try another store.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Vaults are the big robbery jobs — the 100% checklist counts 8 bank vault robberies, so robbing 8 covers both the trophy and the checklist.

steps.t: Bank vaults are marked robbery targets; plan a fast car and an escape route first.
Rob a vault and escape; each completed vault adds 1 to the count.
A vault robbery gives you a 4-star Wanted Level at once — that also feeds Hot Together.
The 100% checklist counts 8 vault robberies, so rob 8 and both the trophy and the checklist are covered.
The silver pops on the fifth vault escape.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Trucks run set routes — block one, crack it open, take the cash and lose the heat.

steps.t: Find an Armored Truck on its route and block it with your car.
Crack the truck open and take the cash.
Escape the Wanted Level to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive, fly and walk the whole state — Vice City, the swamps, the Keys, the mountains — until every area on the map is visited.

steps.t: There are 52 areas in Leonida; the map tracks which ones you have visited.
Work region by region: Vice City, then the Keys, the swamps, the farmland and the mountains.
Fly between distant areas and drive the rest; a WAiNK scan in each area helps confirm it.
The 100% checklist also wants the state explored, so this trophy and the checklist finish together.
The trophy pops when the 52nd area is visited.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. The 100% checklist wants 39 Gang Operations in total, so this trophy pops on the way to the checklist.

steps.t: There are 9 gangs in Leonida, each with its own illegal operations.
Rob one operation per gang; the map and the gang intel mark them.
The 100% checklist needs 39 Gang Operations, so keep robbing past the ninth gang.
The trophy pops once all 9 gangs have been hit.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact spot is still being pinned down by the guide community — head to a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and enjoy the view.

steps.t: Go to Ocean Beach and find a beachfront bar with a view over the water.
Order a cocktail and drink it with the view; the method is still being confirmed by guides.
The trophy pops when the cocktail is enjoyed; check the sources for the exact bar as they confirm it.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The exact showroom is still being pinned down — drive a car through a showroom window and out the other side.

steps.t: Find a vehicle showroom in Vice City and drive a car at its window.
Smash through the showroom and out the other side in one run.
The trophy pops on the smash-out; check the sources for the exact showroom as they confirm it.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go bowling there and play a full game — the follow-through is the point.

steps.t: Go to the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley in Vice City.
Play a full game of bowling and follow through on your throws.
The trophy pops when the game is done.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal. The exact trigger is still being pinned down — it seems tied to a partner activity done well in front of a crowd.

steps.t: Play partner activities with Lucia or Jason and aim for a standout result.
The method is still being confirmed by guides; check the sources for the latest trigger.
The trophy pops when the partnership moment lands.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Choices and actions across the game feed the profile — play naturally, make choices, and the count climbs to 500.

steps.t: Your Criminal Profile tracks the choices you make; 500 profile actions are needed.
Make choices in missions and in the open world — each one that affects the profile counts.
Avoid the Irredeemable criminal profile: it is permanent and makes the police more aggressive.
The trophy pops at 500 profile actions.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The exact trigger is still being pinned down — it seems tied to succeeding at something on the second attempt after failing once.

steps.t: Fail something once, then succeed at the same thing on the second try.
The method is still being confirmed by guides; check the sources for the latest trigger.
The trophy pops when the second attempt succeeds.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The exact trigger is still being pinned down — it seems tied to a strange random event somewhere in Leonida. Keep playing and check the sources as they confirm it.

steps.t: This one is tied to a strange event in the open world; no guide has pinned the trigger yet.
Explore odd places in Leonida — the swamps, the Keys, the desert roads — and watch for something strange.
The trophy pops when the event happens; check the sources for the latest trigger.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. The exact method is still being pinned down — it seems tied to knocking someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle.

steps.t: Get a vehicle moving and attack with a melee weapon from it — a drive-by with a bat, not a gun.
Knock someone over with the melee drive-by; the method is still being confirmed by guides.
The trophy pops when the drive-by lands.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies — launder them through your contacts a little at a time and the total climbs.

steps.t: Marked Bills come from robberies: vaults, trucks and gang operations pay in them.
Launder the bills through your contacts; each laundered dollar adds to the $250,000 total.
Robberies are the fastest source, so this trophy finishes with the robbery grind.
The trophy pops at $250,000 laundered.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Heists and robberies pay for it — buy weapons, clothes, cars and upgrades, and the total climbs on its own.

steps.t: Spend money in any shop: weapons, clothes, cars, upgrades and food all count.
Heist and robbery cash pays for it; the total climbs as you play.
The trophy pops at $100,000 spent.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. There are 8 garages to buy, each with 1 parking spot — buy them all and the trophy pops.

steps.t: There are 8 garage properties to buy, each with 1 parking spot.
Garages are sold across Leonida; check the property listings on the map.
Buy them one by one as the cash comes in from robberies and heists.
The trophy pops on the eighth purchase.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles, open the Scooter Bros app, and register them — 10 registrations and the trophy pops.

steps.t: Open the Scooter Bros app on the in-game phone.
Register a vehicle you own or find; each registration adds 1.
The trophy pops at 10 registered vehicles.
